## Summary

What changed and why, in a few sentences. Cite the open question identifiers (O-IDs) and architecture decision records (ADRs) the change follows.

## Requirement IDs

R IDs closed:

- [ ] R0.0: what the proof is (test name or command)

## Tests run

Commands and their results, copied from the terminal:

- `just ci`: result
- `command`: result

## Gates

- [ ] Plan approved before implementation
- [ ] Tests green (nothing advanced on red)
- [ ] Code review done, CRITICAL and HIGH findings fixed
- [ ] Security review done when auth, user input, secrets, endpoints or CI changed
- [ ] Privacy guard clean (`just guard-ci`), nothing GTO Wizard-specific added

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything the reviewer should look at first, open questions, or follow-ups left for a later session.
